title: Require external anchor evidence on high-autonomy work
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. High-autonomy graphs must periodically attach labeled external anchors so branches cannot drift on mutually reinforcing model judgments alone. Accepts WalkingLabs L14 guidance[^wl-l14-anchor].
implementation: `AnchorRequirement`, `AnchorEvidence`, and `anchors_satisfied` in `mechaharness.anchor_evidence` label and require anchor kinds.
validation: Harness `user_story` drives product verb(s) with environment `pass_through`/`mock`; hard expects on declared observation keys.
